chapter: Cafe Society and the Zodiac Suite
title: Dewey Square Hotel, John Hammond and Cafe Society
summary: Stranded, she stayed in the Dewey Square Hotel to think. Through John Hammond and Louise Crane, she was booked into Cafe Society downtown, where she stayed off and on for five years.

story.theme_name: Coming to New York: clubs, jams, and making it
story.community_name: Making it in New York: arrival, clubs and the scene

blocks.x: What I did - I was here practically stranded in New York except I wouldn't tell anyone. I got myself a room at the hotel, Dewey Square Hotel, and I stayed inside that hotel. I ate and slept for about 2 weeks. I called John Hammond; he got me in touch with Louise Crane - you know the Crane paper, C-r-a-n-e? I think they - stationery or something. John Hammond booked me into the Cafe Society downtown. I just slept and thought over things and meditated as to which way I was going.
What did Louise Crane do for you?
I think through John Hammond she booked us into acts. Kelly's Stable. She was trying to book/ She had a couple of people like Baby Laurence or something like that, or some other dancer.
She had nothing to do with the paper business?

No, she was quite rich. She was trying her hand at booking musicians and things like that. I was with her a while and it didn't work out because I'm more or less at home around men. So what I did was, as I said before, I stayed in the Dewey Square Hotel trying to think things out, so John Hammond says, "Well, I have a place for you, Cafe Society." So I went downtown. This was between '41 and '42, 1941 and 1942 that I went into the Cafe. I stayed in the Cafe off and on for 5 years.
